title: Punctured root charts commute with cofiltered affine ring colimits
statement: Let R,H be commutative rings, f in R, n a natural number, and b:R -> H. Let I be a small cofiltered category, F:I^op -> CommRing, c a colimit cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], a:const R -> F a natural transformation, and e:c.pt -> H an isomorphism such that a_j;c.iota_j;e=b for every j. Put V_H=D(b(f)) in Spec(H[T]/(T^n-b(f))), with its natural map k_H to Spec R [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. There are a scheme diagram D:I -> Scheme, a limiting cone c1 and t:D -> const Spec R, with each D(j) affine, and an isomorphism E:V_H -> c1.pt such that E;pi_j;t_j=k_H for every j. For each j, let S=F(op j), a_j=a.app(op j), V_S=D(a_j(f)) in Spec(S[T]/(T^n-a_j(f))) and k_S its natural map to Spec R. There is an isomorphism d_j:V_S -> D(j) with d_j;t_j=k_S. No etaleness, geometric point, regularity or positivity assumption is made.

proof.text: Use punctured_root_base_change to identify each chart, including the H chart, with the pullback of the fixed basic-open root chart over R. The base chart is affine by Mathlib IsAffineOpen.Spec_basicOpen.

Apply Spec to c₀ and its colimit proof. Extend the resulting limit cone along Spec(e₀). Use ha and contravariant functoriality to verify each leg followed by Spec(a_j) is Spec(b). Lift this limiting cone to Over(Spec R) using Over.isLimitLiftCone.

Apply Over.pullback of the fixed root-chart map, which preserves limits as a right adjoint, then Over.forget, which preserves connected limits. Cofilteredness implies connectedness. Define the stage base maps by the first projections. Pullbacks of the affine stages and the affine root chart over Spec R are affine. Use the chart isomorphisms at H and at each stage, their first-projection formulas, and the cone-leg equations to verify both requested structural equalities.

mathlib_searches.results: 8 hits, including Localization.awayEquivAdjoin and IsLocalization.adjoin_inv; no colimit theorem for the indicated root charts. AdjoinRoot queried with Loogle: definition and algebra structure, no continuity theorem.

StrictHenselization supplies the coordinate-ring colimit and cofilteredness; StrictHenselizationStructuralMap supplies the leg formula. The exact pointed ring presentation is not named. Root colimit continuity is not stated; existing localization colimits concern localizations at primes or modules.

lean.statement: theorem punctured_root_colimit_continuity (R H : CommRingCat.{u}) (f : R) (n : ℕ) (b : R ⟶ H) (I : Type u) [Category.{u} I] [IsCofiltered I] (F : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c₀ : Cocone F) (hc₀ : IsColimit c₀) (a : (Functor.const Iᵒᵖ).obj R ⟶ F) (e₀ : c₀.pt ≅ H) (ha : ∀ j, a.app j ≫ c₀.ι.app j ≫ e₀.hom = b) : let g := b.hom f let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ n - Polynomial.C g) let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A) let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H A)) let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g) ∃ (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (t : D ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj (Spec R)), Nonempty (IsLimit c) ∧ (∀ j, IsAffine (D.obj j)) ∧ ∃ e : V.toScheme ≅ c.pt, (∀ j, e.hom ≫ c.π.app j ≫ t.app j = V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map b) ∧ ∀ j, let S := F.obj (Opposite.op j) let g := (a.app (Opposite.op j)).hom f let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ n - Polynomial.C g) let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A) let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S A)) let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap S A g) ∃ d : V.toScheme ≅ D.obj j, d.hom ≫ t.app j = V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map (a.app (Opposite.op j))
